no_api_findings.finding: The versioned standard-library inventory has no Matrix Market decoder. io.Reader and os.Open provide input bytes, while encoding defines generic marshaling interfaces; none interprets the Matrix Market header, dimensions, or entries. No documented format-aware bundled API was available to run against the control.

limit: This covers documented Go 1.27.2 standard-library APIs; third-party modules and installed native libraries are separate.
